read: ENGROH popped 3.39% today after a flat month (ret_20d -0.65%), pushing RSI14 back up through 52.4 and price back above the SMA50 (273.96) though still just under the SMA20 (283.51). The move came on below-average volume (vol_surge 0.73), so it reads as a reclaim rather than a breakout, sitting 4.39% off the 20-day high.
liquidity_note: Avg daily traded value of PKR 1,241.6m is deep; entry/exit should be clean with minimal slippage.

claim.text: Having reclaimed RSI-50 and the SMA50 (273.96), ENGROH clears the SMA20 (283.51) and tests the 20-day high (~294) within 20 sessions from 2026-07-16.
